## About {#about}

Welcome to my website! My name is Fankai Dai. I am currently a Ph.D. student in the School of Future Media at the University of Hong Kong, supervised by [Prof. King-wa Fu](https://sites.google.com/site/fukingwa/) and [Prof. Bin Chen](https://binchen19.github.io).

My research interests include digital journalism, political communication, and platform governance.

Previously, I received my B.A. from the College of Media and International Culture at Zhejiang University and my M.A. from the School of Journalism and Communication at Tsinghua University.

- Zhou, R., Wang, W., **Dai, F.**, & Zhou, Z. (2021). Learning to make news: How Chinese college students and faculty covered the Covid-19 pandemic. *Shanghai Journalism Review* (CSSCI), 11, 53–65.
